document_id: Krausmann 2014 - STREST report on lessons learned from recent catastrophic events

hazards.source_text: tsunami earthquakes had been expected to occur with 20% probability in the coming 30 years in the region near the Japan trench between the northern Sanriku coast and the Boso Peninsula (Fujiwara and Morikawa, 2012).

evidence.quote: tsunami earthquakes had been expected to occur with 20% probability in the coming 30 years in the region near the Japan trench between the northern Sanriku coast and the Boso Peninsula (Fujiwara and Morikawa, 2012).

hazards.source_text: The Headquarters for Earthquake Research Promotion (HERP) had warned of the occurrence of an earthquake in offshore Miyagi Prefecture with a probability of 99% and MJMA = 7.5 within 30 years.

evidence.quote: The Headquarters for Earthquake Research Promotion (HERP) had warned of the occurrence of an earthquake in offshore Miyagi Prefecture with a probability of 99% and MJMA = 7.5 within 30 years.

hazards.source_text: The earthquake ruptured over several segments, which had been evaluated as independent earthquakes (Goto and Morikawa, 2012).

evidence.quote: The earthquake ruptured over several segments, which had been evaluated as independent earthquakes (Goto and Morikawa, 2012).

hazards.source_text: The Cosmo Oil refinery is located in Tokyo Bay (Chiba Prefecture) and was subjected to only low levels of earthquake forces.

evidence.quote: The Cosmo Oil refinery is located in Tokyo Bay (Chiba Prefecture) and was subjected to only low levels of earthquake forces.

hazards.source_text: Unknown to the refinery operator, the first earthquake shock damaged the braces on an LPG tank that at the time of the earthquake was filled with water for maintenance reasons.

evidence.quote: Unknown to the refinery operator, the first earthquake shock damaged the braces on an LPG tank that at the time of the earthquake was filled with water for maintenance reasons.

hazards.source_text: The second shock caused the weakened braces of the tank to buckle and subsequently the tank to collapse.

evidence.quote: The second shock caused the weakened braces of the tank to buckle and subsequently the tank to collapse.

hazards.source_text: This ruptured the LPG pipes connected to the tank and led to the release of flammable gases that eventually ignited (Cosmo Oil, 2011a; Krausmann and Cruz, 2013).

evidence.quote: This ruptured the LPG pipes connected to the tank and led to the release of flammable gases that eventually ignited (Cosmo Oil, 2011a; Krausmann and Cruz, 2013).

hazards.source_text: Due to heat impingement by the fire on the other storage tanks, they ruptured via boiling liquid expanding vapour explosions (BLEVE).

evidence.quote: Due to heat impingement by the fire on the other storage tanks, they ruptured via boiling liquid expanding vapour explosions (BLEVE).

hazards.source_text: The refinery's LPG storage tank farm was completely destroyed, as well as surrounding pipelines and roads (Fig. 2.1).

evidence.quote: The refinery's LPG storage tank farm was completely destroyed, as well as surrounding pipelines and roads (Fig. 2.1).

hazards.source_text: Adjacent asphalt tanks were damaged to due debris impact, and fires broke out in two neighbouring petrochemical facilities.

evidence.quote: Adjacent asphalt tanks were damaged to due debris impact, and fires broke out in two neighbouring petrochemical facilities.

hazards.source_text: The fire caused by ignition of LPG from the broken pipes propagated to the other pressurised tanks which suffered BLEVEs.

evidence.quote: The fire caused by ignition of LPG from the broken pipes propagated to the other pressurised tanks which suffered BLEVEs.

hazards.source_text: The explosions damaged nearby asphalt tanks due to debris impact, causing asphalt to leak into the ocean (Cosmo Oil, 2011a).

evidence.quote: The explosions damaged nearby asphalt tanks due to debris impact, causing asphalt to leak into the ocean (Cosmo Oil, 2011a).

hazards.source_text: In addition, dispersion of flammable LPG vapours and burning missile projection from the explosions started fires in two neighbouring chemical facilities, with subsequent hazardous-materials releases (Krausmann and Cruz, 2013).

evidence.quote: In addition, dispersion of flammable LPG vapours and burning missile projection from the explosions started fires in two neighbouring chemical facilities, with subsequent hazardous-materials releases (Krausmann and Cruz, 2013).
